Ɓuri moƴƴude e mon ko oon jannguɗo Quraana o janngani mbo

Kala jannguɗo harfeere e deftere ALLA woodana mbo heen moƴƴere, te moƴƴere sowete yeruuji sappo

wotee ngooŋɗinee jom en defte wotee penneeɓe, mbi'ee:" min ngooŋɗanii Alla e ko tellina ko e amen
Annabi anndaano keerol simoore (sorawol)haa tellii(jippe) e makko " bismillaahi arrahmaani arrahiimi",
jom Quraana ina wi'e: janngu ɓamta, taro hono tarortonoɗa e aduna, daraja ma tolnii ko e aaya cakkitiɗa janngude o
ɓe njanngintone Quraana ummaade e nelaaɗo aayaaje sappo, ɓe ƴettataana goɗɗe si wonah ɓe nganndu ko woni e ɗeen aayeeje e gannadal e gollirde ngal
